description: Questions that ask for several things at once, the case the decomposeQuestion branch exists for (docs/system-plan.md Phase 9d). Each part carries its own expectedDocument and mustContain, so coverage is measured per part: a single query for the whole question tends to answer the strongest part and drop the rest. Parts without an expectedDocument are negatives — the corpus does not answer that part, and no split may turn it into evidence.
